name: work-experience

frames.best_why: All three job cards show logos, dates, roles and skill chips with no cursor covering them.
frames.render_note: Root has no background: the dark heading and timeline line are almost invisible on the black stage.

tagline: Past jobs as white cards strung down a thin dotted timeline.
summary: A vertical career timeline of three white cards, each with a company logo, role, period, location, a one-line summary and small skill pills, joined by a faint line with small badge nodes.
appearance: A nearly black page holding three white rounded cards in a centred stack. Each card starts with a round logo, a bold company name and a small external-link arrow, a grey role, a pin with a city, then a short paragraph and four pale rounded skill chips. A faint vertical line links small knot-shaped icons down the left.
behaviour: On load the cards slide in from the left in sequence and their skill chips pop in one by one. Hovering a card lifts it a few pixels and hovering a chip darkens it slightly.
demo_content: Roles at OpenAI, Stripe and Airbnb with dates, cities and stacks like React, Go and Kubernetes.
search_phrases: career path with dates and roles
cv list with location and skills
use_when: A portfolio or résumé page needs a vertical timeline of jobs with logos and skill tags.
avoid_when: It assumes a light page: the root has no background, so its dark heading vanishes on a dark stage.
customise: The three jobs, descriptions, links, logo URLs and skill lists are hardcoded; the node icon and palette also need source edits.
weight_why: Three cards and their chips animate briefly on mount, then everything is idle.

a11y.note: Company links are reachable by tab, but the hover lift and chip colour have no keyboard equivalent; motion ignores reduced-motion.

issues: With no background on the root, the heading and timeline line disappear on the dark stage.
The footer stat tiles sit below the frames and are never shown.
The OpenAI card links to Linear's site, so company links are mismatched.
polish_why: White cards are tidy, but the missing page background makes the header vanish on black.
